evidence.phase_loop: H01 official: recruit, automatic combat, hero damage and elimination
evidence.damage_formula_and_ghost: H03 contemporary community account: winner tier plus surviving minion tiers; draw zero; odd-player ghost may damage live player
evidence.card_tiers: H03 tier index cross-matched to H04 build 35747 card definitions
evidence.combat_snapshot: H01/H03 phase semantics; exact persistence and serialization are reference design

reference_decisions.pairings: caller injects a complete disjoint matching of living seats; odd count requires one ghost from a previously eliminated seat
reference_decisions.combat_engine_boundary: caller injects terminal survivor IDs and a generated-token manifest; reducer validates identity and computes outcome, never simulates attacks
reference_decisions.snapshot: deep-copy locked recruitment boards and tavern tiers before combat; no combat mutation is written to recruit boards
reference_decisions.damage: draw gives zero; surviving winner deals own tavern tier plus each surviving minion damage tier; a ghost can damage a living loser but cannot take damage
reference_decisions.token_tier: combat-generated token damage tier is caller supplied with reference_injected grade and must not be presented as original server fact
reference_decisions.elimination: apply all pair results in one atomic action, then eliminate seats at health zero or below; preserve original boards as eligible ghost snapshots
reference_decisions.placement: winner_id is known when exactly one seat remains; simultaneous elimination placements remain unknown
reference_decisions.next_round: emit an advance_recruit hook for each living seat; per-seat shop, coin and discount mutation belongs to historical-recruitment-transitions.json
reference_decisions.recruit_hero_immunity: only a board-present Mal'Ganis on the damaged seat prevents the bounded Wrath Weaver damage event; the card-play trigger is reference-injected and stat growth is modeled separately
reference_decisions.combat_hero_immunity: derive immunity at hero-damage settlement from terminal survivor IDs, never from the preserved recruitment board; a losing side has no survivors, so its Mal'Ganis does not suppress combat damage in this reference model
